name: SPIZZICHINO
description: Spizzichino (or 'Pizzichino') is a complex two-player Italian card game played with a 40-card deck (Italian suits). It combines elements of Briscola (trick-taking) and Scopa (capture/fishing) with meld-making (similar to Bezique/Pinochle). The name likely refers to 'picking' or 'nibbling' at points in small increments. The game is highly strategic and lesser-known outside Italy.

content.text: Spizzichino (or 'Pizzichino') is a complex two-player Italian card game played with a 40-card deck (Italian suits). It combines elements of Briscola (trick-taking) and Scopa (capture/fishing) with meld-making (similar to Bezique/Pinochle). The name likely refers to 'picking' or 'nibbling' at points in small increments. The game is highly strategic and lesser-known outside Italy.
Dates to the 18th or 19th century. A hybrid of Tressette mechanics (ranking 3-2-A) and Scopa capture? No, usually Tressette ranking.

Two players; they take turns to deal. Each player has a hand of 10 cards and two face-up packets of 5 cards on the table (only the top card of each packet is visible). Play is from hand or from the top of a packet.
40-card Italian pack (Latin suits). In some regions a 40-card French pack with Queen replacing Cavallo.

Dealer shuffles and creates eight packets of 5 cards face down. Opponent chooses four packets: two placed face-up on the table (top card visible only), two picked up as a 10-card hand. Dealer does the same with the other four. Each player has a 10-card hand and two face-up packets of 5 cards.

items.text: Look at bottom of packets: Before choosing which packets to turn up, each player may look at the bottom card of their own packets.
No buongiochi: Buongiochi are not declared or scored; game is played to 21 or 31 points instead of 51.

Tressette in Due a Metà Mazzo: Alternative variant: deal 10 each, 20 cards as stock. After each trick both players draw from stock (winner first) and show the card. Declare buongiochi before first trick or when a draw completes a new combination. Game to 21, 31, 41 or 51.
